rebecca_fin: Meridian flagged a retro charge on invoice 84521 (TKT-6622). They were promised a partner pilot credit but it didn't apply. asking for $4,200 credit + corrected invoice.

sam_csm: oof. can you paste the lines? need SKU codes for the memo.

rebecca_fin: invoice snippet:
```
Invoice 84521
- Reserved cluster (MER-RESV): $8,400
- Usage: $1,150
- Discounts: $0 (expected PILOT_PARTNER50)
Total: $9,550
```

matt_billing: was promo percent off reserved only? sales note says "50% reserved for pilot month".

sam_csm: confirmed with AE: 50% off reserved only. expected credit = $4,200.

elaine_cfo: fine to approve $4.2k one-time pilot credit. which GL?

matt_billing: GL = 5125 (Partner pilot credits). i'll generate credit memo CM-2026-0322 and reissue invoice 84521-R1. reason tag: "PILOT_PARTNER50_ADJ".

elaine_cfo: approved. add justification: "Partner pilot credit promised but not applied; TKT-6622". :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-0322 created for $4,200. Reissued invoice 84521-R1 (net due $5,350). Link: https://billing.internal/reports/invoice/84521-R1

matt_billing: emailed CM + corrected invoice to Meridian, cc'd AE and CS. adding requirement: sales must submit promo token via billing webhook 48h before cutoff.

rebecca_fin: thanks all. logging retro item on pricing-experiments board to improve promo propagation. will close once Meridian confirms receipt.
